text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 3s for router-service in eu-west-1 (streaming stalls observed). Paging @oncall.
Jesse (oncall): I'm on it. Paging Lina and Megan. Any obvious SIGs from telemetry?
Dynamo-monitor-bot: p95 750ms -> 1.2s; p99 jumped 220ms -> 3.4s in last 4m. Increase in streaming stalls reported by 31% of sessions. Error surface: 502 spikes correlated with backend timeouts.
Lina (sre): seeing heavy tail on router egress to shard group shard-eu-12. Hotkeys look concentrated; consistent hash distribution skewed. Rolling policy version bumped to `ingress-weight-v2` ~5m before spike.
Megan (runtime): Confirmed. `ingress-weight-v2` changed weight-to-zone map and introduced affinity overrides. New hash seed applied on rollout. Logs show misroutes landing on single hot partition:
```
2026-03-15T09:41:02Z router[euw]: route_request id=xyz shard=shard-eu-12 policy=ingress-weight-v2 -> backend=svc-infer-12a
2026-03-15T09:41:03Z router[euw]: router queue depth 128 -> queued_ms=4500
```
Jesse (oncall): Is this causing streaming stalls (open connections held) or CPU saturation on the shard nodes?
Megan (runtime): Both. svc-infer-12a CPU 97%, qps per worker doubled. KV-cache OOM on a worker leading to regen stalls. Streaming connections backlog rising -> stall tail.
Lina (sre): We need immediate mitigation: 1) revert policy to `ingress-weight-v1` 2) eject shard-eu-12 from router table (soft-eject) so it drains 3) open temporary routing fallback to replica pool (zone spill) 4) notify support/customer-impact.
Victor (product): Customer impact: a subset of streaming customers in EU region seeing degraded interactive responses and reconnects. Priority accounts flagged by alert rules.
Jesse (oncall): Rolling rollback now. Executing deploy rollback api call.
Jesse (oncall): `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/policy/ingress-weight/rollback -d '{"target":"ingress-weight-v1","region":"eu-west-1"}'`
incident-bot: Deploy rollback job queued. Job ID abc-rollback-2499. ETA ~30s.
Dynamo-monitor-bot: rollback acknowledged. Telemetry will show routing table rebalance in ~60s.
Megan (runtime): While rollback runs, doing soft-eject of shard-eu-12 to stop new routes: `./rb-router eject --shard shard-eu-12 --mode soft --reason "hotshard"`.
Lina (sre): Also enabling temporary load-shed for low-priority streaming sessions: `config.route.stream.shed=false -> true (low_priority)`.
Jesse (oncall): Noted. I'll start running `tail` on router logs and fetch heap/cpu on nodes.
Megan (runtime): Patch applied: soft-eject executed. Kicking connection drain. Starting replication spill to replica pool.
Lina (sre): Observability: queue depth on affected routers dropping. p99 dropping from 3.4s -> 1.5s now.
Dynamo-monitor-bot: p99 now 1.48s (3m post-mitigation). Streaming stall rate down 18%.
Victor (product): Can we confirm no data loss? Any partial responses dropped?
Megan (runtime): No evidence of dropped responses; timeouts and reconnects were happening because stall > idle timers. We are draining connections gracefully.
Jesse (oncall): Rolling rollback completed (job abc-rollback-2499 success). Confirming policy version `ingress-weight-v1` across eu-west-1.
Lina (sre): Post-rollback telemetry: route distribution rebalanced. Hotkey skew persists slightly due to cache warming but p99 trending to baseline.
Megan (runtime): Follow-ups: 1) revert should be studied — `ingress-weight-v2` introduced non-uniform hash seeding. 2) run targeted eval with live traffic sampler for top 100 keys. 3) add pre-rollout heatmap check to rollout pipeline.
Jesse (oncall): Creating incident ticket and assigning to runtime + routing owners. Will page on-call infra for capacity increase if reoccurs.
Victor (product): Notifying affected customer contacts with a short incident note. Please include ETA/resolution steps and mitigation details.
Lina (sre): Quick RCA notes to capture now: root cause: policy rollout `ingress-weight-v2` changed hashing/affinity in a way that concentrated requests for a subset of tenant keys onto shard-eu-12 -> hot partition -> CPU/kv-cache pressure -> streaming stalls -> p99 spike. Contributing factor: rollout lacked preflight heatmap and candidate simulation.
Megan (runtime): Action items (owners):
- Megan: run forensic trace for top 10 keys -> `/run/forensic/topkeys --region eu-west-1 --shard shard-eu-12` (due 2h)
- Lina: add rollout gate to CI to simulate key distribution heatmap (PR open) (due 24h)
- Jesse: update runbook for soft-eject & rollback steps + add checklist (done in 1h)
- Victor: customer comms draft and send (ASAP)
Jesse (oncall): Any risk of rollback flipping other regions? Rollback targeted region-specific, control-plane scoped.
Megan (runtime): Safe. We restricted rollback to region. No global churn.
Lina (sre): Final telemetry snapshot: p95 420ms (baseline 380ms), p99 620ms (baseline 580ms). Marking degraded->mitigated. Will keep incident open for follow-up RCA.
incident-bot: Incident escalated to SEV-2. Incident timeline recorded. Please update postmortem channel when done.
Victor (product): Thx team. I'll coordinate customer comms and flag for follow-up with product-routing sync.
Jesse (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Leaving incident open for RCA and action item tracking. If tail spikes reappear, escalate to livepage.
Megan (runtime): Noted. I'll collect debug bundles and upload to `s3://infra-incident-dumps/2499990001/`.
Lina (sre): Offshift handoff in 45m. @Jesse please follow up on list items. Logging final note here and will start RCA doc.
Jesse (oncall): Acknowledged. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
